scope: Dedicated forge workbench and responsive crafting UI

portable.coverage: All recipes and sets, 30,000 deterministic loot rolls, crafting conservation and save migration

native_checks: 1280x800: visual gear picker, large selected gear and socket preview, six operation tabs, material icons and visible transaction cost.
640x480: dedicated forge page; fixed collapsible action chooser; full-width gear strip and separate picker; workbench scroll reaches the craft button.
Add socket: Essence 200 -> 188; selected rare sword 0 -> 1 socket.
Insert Rough Ruby: material count 6 -> 5, filled socket artwork appears, insertion disables when full.
Socketed gear: salvage disabled with extraction requirement.
Extract: Essence 188 -> 180; socket empties; Rough Ruby returns to 6.
Runeworks: ordered icons and bonuses shown; Prepare these runes selects Em and the Runes category for Kindling.
Salvage: first click shows item-specific confirmation and Keep this item; cancellation leaves item and Essence intact; confirmed salvage removes the test sword and Essence 180 -> 190.
Compact: action switching, item chooser, item selection and Add socket transaction observed.
Compact: recipe chooser replaces always-visible recipe list.
art: Code-native faceted gem icons, engraved rune tablets and Essence emblem; existing OoT-style stone backdrop, native lettering and yellow selection cursors retained.
isolation: Temporary SHIP_HOME profiles with SOH_ARPG_SANDBOX=1 and SOH_ARPG_FORGE_PREVIEW=1; no player saves modified.
limits: Physical controller not attached; controller input not physically tested.
Short windows scroll the workbench; primary action navigation remains fixed.
